'''Telgorn dropship''' was a variant of [[Transport/Legends|space transport]] manufactured by [[Telgorn Corporation/Legends|Telgorn Corporation]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] used a modified Telgorn dropship, ''[[Sleight of Hand]]'' as his personal transport vessel.

==Appearances==
*''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 1: Breakout Squad]]''
*''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 2: Curse of the Black Hole Pirates]]''
*''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' {{1st}}
